faq.q: What is a titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: A titanium dive watch crown is a precision-machined wearable hardware component used in threaded screw-down crown for dive watch. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is the surface finish achieved on titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: Titanium Dive Watch Crown receives PVD coating (ISO 27874, Delta-E <=1.0 color accuracy) for wear resistance and aesthetics, plus oleophobic AFP nano-coating (water contact angle >110 deg) to resist fingerprints and skin oils.

faq.q: What CNC equipment is used for titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: Titanium Dive Watch Crown is machined on 5-axis CNC equipment with high-pressure coolant (1000 psi) to manage titanium's low thermal conductivity and work-hardening tendency. Tolerances of +-0.01mm are standard.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
